description:
This is the raw, unfiltered moment rapper XeroGangg lays it all down—secular music, drugs, and the lifestyle that came with it—to follow Jesus.

So many chase fame, fortune, and followers… but XeroGangg realized none of it could compare to the truth and freedom found in Christ. This isn’t just a feel-good moment. This is real repentance. A turning point. A new beginning.

✝️ “Therefore, if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature...” – 2 Corinthians 5:17

God is still raising up warriors from the streets, from the stages, from the darkest places—to shine the light of truth in a world drowning in deception.

#XeroGangg #Testimony #JesusSaves #ChristianHipHop #FromDarknessToLight #Repentance #CandidTruth #NewLifeInChrist #2Corinthians517
